fix 2026-10-13 (session 50): decoupled the artifact upload from gate pass/fail. continue-on-error: true added to the 'Upload debug APK' step in .github/workflows/verify.yml (the required gate) and to the 'Upload Debug APK' step in .github/workflows/main.yml (build job). The gate itself still fails closed if the APK does not build; the upload carries no additional pass/fail signal. This removes a recurring infra false-negative that would otherwise block every future PR merge (branch protection requires the Verify context).
